device_types.description: Physical acquisition node (e.g., parking radar, ultrasonic sensor, light sensor). Primarily emits events.
Physical actuation node (e.g., relay, barrier, LED signaling). Primarily receives commands.
Local routing and translation unit. Provides the binary (RFC-0100) <-> JSON (RFC-0002) interface.
Interaction terminal or user kiosk (e.g., payment screen, reception kiosk).
